items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 05 August 2026 at 7:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Slow moving area of low pressure over Scotland as various frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest, veering west or northwest late this afternoon, 5 or 6, occasionally increasing 7 in places until around midnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally locally rough until later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain or showers soon developing. Becoming mainly fair again later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, quickly decreasing 4 or 5, backing mainly west or southwest 3 or 4 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
